## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem this fixes or the task this enables. Link related issues if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. Explain any checks you could not run. Include screenshots for visible UI changes, with personal information removed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for private data, game/mod content and generated files.
- [ ] I ran checks appropriate to the change and described the results above.
- [ ] I updated both UI languages and relevant documentation where applicable.
- [ ] I checked draft preservation, cancellation and file/process safeguards where affected, or explained why they are not applicable.

Do not submit security vulnerability details in a public pull request; use the reporting route in SECURITY.md.
